summary: Implemented responsive, accessible Mediterranean restaurant UI for Ember & Olive per .team/CONTRACTS.md and UX research handoff tokens. Includes Hero, Menu with dietary filters, 2-step Reservation form with strict validation and input preservation, Restaurant Info, and full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.

contracts.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant (contrast ratios >= 4.5:1, high-contrast focus rings, skip-to-content link, semantic HTML, ARIA live regions, 44x44px minimum touch targets)

tests.build: vite build -> dist/index.html (1.08 kB), dist/assets/index.css (4.84 kB), dist/assets/index.js (277 kB)
